info.name: Zehire API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Zehire Backend.

## Setup

1. Set the `base_url` variable to your environment (default: `http://localhost:8787`)
2. Use **Auth > Login** to initiate magic link login
3. Check your email and copy the token from the magic link
4. Use **Auth > Callback** with the token - JWT will be auto-saved
5. All authenticated endpoints will use the saved JWT automatically

## Variables

- `base_url`: API base URL
- `jwt_token`: JWT token (auto-saved after callback)
- `job_id`: Current job ID for testing
- `public_slug`: Public job slug for testing
- `draft_id`: Application draft ID (auto-saved)
- `resume_token`: Draft resume token (auto-saved)
- `application_id`: Application ID for testing

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Magic link authentication endpoints.

**Flow:**
1. POST /auth/login with email
2. Check email for magic link
3. GET /auth/callback with token (or copy token from email)
4. JWT is auto-saved to collection variable

request.description:
Initiate magic link login.

**Response:** 204 No Content on success (email sent)

Check your email for the magic link with token.

exec: // Auto-save JWT token from session cookie
console.log('JWT token saved to collection variable');

request.description:
Complete magic link authentication.

**Steps:**
1. Copy the token from the magic link in your email
2. Replace `PASTE_TOKEN_HERE` with the actual token
3. Send request
4. JWT will be auto-saved to `jwt_token` collection variable

**Response:** User info with session cookie

Get current authenticated user info.

Requires valid JWT token.

Clear session cookie.

**Response:** 204 No Content

item.name: Jobs
item.description:
Job management endpoints.

All endpoints require JWT authentication.

**Job Lifecycle:**
```
draft → published → paused → closed
         ↑___________|
              resume
```

**Questions Status:**
- none: Not generated
- pending: Queued
- processing: LLM running
- completed: Ready
- failed: Error

**Pipeline Status:**
- none: Not generated
- pending: Queued
- processing: LLM running
- completed: Ready
- failed: Error

**Note:** Both questions AND pipeline must be completed before publishing.

request.description:
List jobs for the authenticated organization.

Supports cursor-based pagination.

exec: // Auto-save job ID for subsequent requests

request.description:
Create a new job as draft.

Does NOT automatically queue for question generation.

**Required fields:**
- title (3-200 chars)
- description: Tiptap JSON document (50-30000 chars extracted text)
- workType: remote, hybrid, onsite
- employmentType: fulltime, parttime, contract, internship

**Optional fields:**
- companyName (max 200 chars)
- department (max 100 chars)
- location (max 200 chars)
- salaryMin (non-negative number)
- salaryMax (>= salaryMin)
- salaryCurrency: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD, IDR

**Tiptap allowed nodes:** doc, paragraph, text, heading, bulletList, orderedList, listItem, blockquote, codeBlock, hardBreak, horizontalRule

**Tiptap allowed marks:** bold, italic, underline, strike, code, link (https only)

Get job status and details.

Response varies by job status (draft includes full editing data, published includes publicSlug).

Update a draft job's content.

**Note:** If `title` or `description` changes, questions and pipeline are reset to `none` and must be regenerated.

Only draft jobs can be updated.

**All fields are optional.**

**Description Format:** Tiptap JSON document with allowed nodes: doc, paragraph, text, heading, bulletList, orderedList, listItem, blockquote, codeBlock, hardBreak, horizontalRule. Allowed marks: bold, italic, underline, strike, code, link.

Delete a draft job.

Only draft jobs can be deleted. Published/paused/closed jobs must be closed and remain for records.

item.name: Lifecycle Actions
item.description:
Job lifecycle management endpoints.

**Flow:**
1. Create draft
2. Generate questions
3. Generate pipeline
4. Publish (starts billing)
5. Pause/Resume as needed
6. Close when done

request.description:
Queue a job for question generation.

**Rate Limits:**
- Maximum 20 regenerations per job
- 1 minute cooldown between regenerations

**Response:** 202 Accepted with `{ "queued": true }`

Poll GET /v1/jobs/:id to check questionsStatus.

Queue a job for pipeline generation.

Pipeline includes:
- Assessment recommendations
- Interview panel structure
- Evaluation criteria

**Rate Limits:**
- Maximum 20 regenerations per job
- 1 minute cooldown between regenerations

**Response:** 202 Accepted with `{ "queued": true }`

Poll GET /v1/jobs/:id to check pipelineStatus.

Get pipeline recommendation and configuration.

Returns:
- pipelineStatus: Current status
- recommendation: LLM-generated recommendation
- config: Editable configuration
- generatedAt: When pipeline was generated

If pipeline not yet generated, recommendation and config will be null.

Update pipeline configuration.

Recruiter can customize:
- Assessment provider and settings
- Interview rounds and interviewers

**Prerequisites:**
- Job must be in `draft` status
- Pipeline must be `completed`

All fields are optional for partial updates.

Reset pipeline configuration to AI recommendation.

This reverts any customizations and regenerates the initial config from the existing recommendation.

**Benefits:**
- No LLM call - instant response
- No token cost - free
- Doesn't count against regeneration limit
- Deterministic - same config from same recommendation

**Prerequisites:**
- Job must be in `draft` status
- Pipeline must be `completed`

Publish a draft job.

**Prerequisites:**
- Job must be in `draft` status
- Questions must be `completed` (questionsStatus)
- Pipeline must be `completed` (pipelineStatus)

**Effects:**
- Generates public slug
- Starts billing
- Job becomes publicly accessible

Pause a published job.

**Effects:**
- Hides job from public view
- Stops billing
- Can be resumed later

Resume a paused job.

**Effects:**
- Makes job public again
- Restarts billing

Close a job permanently.

**Effects:**
- Job can no longer accept applications
- Cannot be reopened
- Billing stops

item.name: Applications
item.description:
Application management endpoints for recruiters.

All endpoints require JWT authentication.

**Application Status Flow:**
```
pending → screening → assessment → interview → offer
                                              ↓
                                          rejected
```

**Decision Postures:**
- LOW_REGRET_RISK: Strong signals, confident hire
- SOME_UNCERTAINTY: Mixed signals, proceed with caution
- HIGH_UNCERTAINTY: Weak signals, higher risk

exec: // Save first application ID if available

query.description: Filter: pending, screening, assessment, interview, offer, rejected, withdrawn

request.description:
List all applications for a job.

**Supports filtering by:**
- `status`: Application pipeline status
- `signalsStatus`: Signal extraction status
- `posture`: Decision posture (after signals computed)

**Pagination:**
- `limit`: Max results (1-100)
- `offset`: Skip first N results

**Sorting:**
- `sort`: createdAt, updatedAt, candidateName
- `order`: asc, desc

Get full application details including answers and extracted signals.

**Returns:**
- Candidate info (email, name)
- Application status
- Signal extraction status and results
- Decision posture
- All answers with extracted signals per answer

**Note:** signalEvaluations and extractedSignals will be null until signal extraction completes.

Update application status to move candidate through the hiring pipeline.

**Valid status values:**
- `pending` - Just submitted
- `screening` - Under initial review
- `assessment` - In assessment phase
- `interview` - Interview scheduled/in progress
- `offer` - Offer extended
- `rejected` - Rejected by recruiter
- `withdrawn` - Withdrawn by candidate

**Typical flow:**
pending → screening → assessment → interview → offer

item.name: Public
item.description:
Public-facing endpoints for candidates.

No authentication required.

**Application Flow:**
1. GET job details to see questions
2. POST apply to submit (all answers required)
3. Optional: Use draft endpoints to save/resume progress

request.description:
Get public job details by slug for candidates.

**No authentication required.**

Only returns published jobs.

Returns: title, companyName, department, location, workType, employmentType, salaryMin, salaryMax, salaryCurrency, description, questions

Submit a complete job application.

**No authentication required.**

**All questions must be answered** (minimum 50 characters each).

**Request body:**
- `email`: Candidate's email (must be valid)
- `name`: Candidate's full name
- `answers`: Array of all question answers
  - `archetypeId`: Question identifier (from job questions)
  - `answerText`: Answer text (min 50 chars)

**Note:** Get question archetypeIds from GET /public/jobs/:slug response.

**Duplicate Prevention:** Returns 409 if email has already applied to this job.

Save application progress for later completion.

**No authentication required.**

Answers can be partial or empty - useful for Save & Continue feature.

**Response includes:**
- `draftId`: Unique draft identifier
- `resumeToken`: Secure token to resume (store this!)
- `expiresAt`: Draft expiry (7 days from creation)
- `progress`: How many questions answered

**Note:** Drafts are auto-deleted when application is submitted.

query.description: Resume token from save draft response

request.description:
Resume a previously saved application draft.

**No authentication required.**

**Query Parameters:**
- `token`: Resume token (required) - received from save draft response

Alternatively, send token in `X-Resume-Token` header.

**Returns:**
- `candidateEmail`: Saved email
- `candidateName`: Saved name
- `answers`: Array of saved answers
- `expiresAt`: When draft expires
- `progress`: Completion status

**Note:** Returns 404 if draft has expired (after 7 days).

item.name: Billing
item.description:
Billing and usage endpoints.

All endpoints require JWT authentication.

**Billing Model:**
- $200/month per active role
- Prorated by milliseconds
- Calendar month billing periods
- Active = published OR paused

request.description:
Get current month usage summary.

Returns:
- Period dates
- Per-job active time breakdown
- Total active job-days
- Billing waiver status

Preview of current charges up to now.

Shows what you would be charged if the billing period ended right now.

Useful for real-time cost tracking.

Get usage for a specific month.

**Path Parameters:**
- year: 2020-2100
- month: 1-12

Example: `/v1/billing/2026/1` for January 2026

Get invoice for a specific month.

**Path Parameters:**
- year: 2020-2100
- month: 1-12

Returns:
- Line items with job details
- Prorated amounts
- Subtotal, discount, total
- Formatted currency strings

**Note:** Cannot generate invoices for future periods.

item.name: Capacity
item.description:
Organization capacity endpoints.

Get capacity status for various resources.

**Currently Available:**
- jobs: Active roles capacity (published + paused jobs)

**Future:**
- users: Team member capacity
- candidates: Candidate pool capacity

request.description:
Get organization capacity status.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "jobs": {
    "activeRoles": 2,
    "capacity": 3,
    "isOverCapacity": false,
    "canActivate": true
  }
}
```

**Fields:**
- `activeRoles`: Count of published + paused jobs
- `capacity`: Maximum allowed active roles
- `isOverCapacity`: True if activeRoles > capacity (soft warning)
- `canActivate`: True if a new role can be published

item.name: Assessment Providers
item.description:
Assessment provider endpoints.

Providers are used when configuring job pipelines.

**Available Providers:**
- hackerrank: Technical assessments
- codility: Coding tests
- testgorilla: Pre-employment testing
- takehome: Custom take-home projects
- none: Skip assessment

request.description:
List all available assessment providers.

Returns provider details including:
- id: Provider identifier (used in pipeline config)
- name: Display name
- type: external or internal
- description: Provider description
- bestFor: Role categories this provider suits
